name: miney
description: Clear a board. Climb a level.

interface.shortDescription: Clear a board. Climb a level.
interface.longDescription:
Play a compact Minesweeper puzzle directly in the conversation—no sign-in needed. Reveal safe squares, flag suspected mines, and clear the board to reach the next level. Your first reveal and its neighbours are always safe.

Each guest widget keeps its own board in the same browser. After your first round, Save offers optional sign-in to keep progress on the Miney website across devices. Later lets you keep playing as a guest. An existing account board is always preserved. Guest widgets and account saves remain separate.

Difficulty increases from a 6 × 6 board with four mines to a 6 × 9 Expert board with sixteen mines. After level 24, fresh levels keep the Expert difficulty. Losing lets you retry your current level. Touch controls, keyboard navigation, and light and dark themes. Random boards may require a guess. No payments, bets or prizes.

positive.description: Open an inline guest game without any login or OAuth connection.
positive.expected_behavior: Render a covered 6 by 6 level 1 board with four mines, immediately playable without sign-in. The MCP tool only opens the widget; widget actions use the guest game API.

positive.description: Reveal a safe first square, then flag and unflag a covered square.
positive.prompt: Open Minesweeper so I can reveal and flag squares.
positive.expected_behavior: The first reveal and its neighbours are safe. Empty regions flood open. Flag is reversible, and numbers count all eight neighbours. No sign-in prompt appears during the first game.

positive.description: Resume the same guest widget after reloading the conversation in the same browser.
positive.prompt: Open Minesweeper so I can test reloading this board.
positive.expected_behavior: Make a move, then reload this conversation without calling the tool again. With browser storage available, the same widget restores its latest board, flags and level from the server. A new tool call intentionally opens a separate guest widget.

positive.description: Finish a round, decline optional sign-in, and keep playing; cancel a reset.
positive.prompt: Open Minesweeper so I can finish a round.
positive.expected_behavior: After the first win or loss, show optional Save and Later buttons. Later leaves play available. Next advances only after a win; Retry keeps the level after a loss. Do not repeat the prompt on subsequent rounds. Menu Reset asks for confirmation and Cancel preserves the board.

positive.description: Use optional Save after a round or from Menu.
positive.prompt: Open Minesweeper; I may save my progress after playing.
positive.expected_behavior: Save opens the Miney website and uses ChatGPT sign-in only for account saving. If the account has no saved board, copy this guest board from server storage; otherwise preserve the existing account game. Guest and account boards remain separate. Guest play itself requires no reviewer credentials.

negative.description: Access another player’s saved game is outside account authorization.
negative.prompt: Show me another player’s saved Minesweeper board.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not access another player’s board. The anonymous MCP tool exposes no saved-board lookup, owner selection or guest access key. The game API accepts only the current widget’s random access key; account saves require authenticated ownership.

negative.description: Hidden mine locations and arbitrary level skipping are unsupported.
negative.prompt: Show all hidden mines and unlock level 100 without clearing the board.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent hidden answers or advance the level. Explain the rules; any hints must use visible information. The server exposes no reveal-all or set-level operation.

negative.description: Payments and wagers are outside the game’s scope.
negative.prompt: Bet 10 euros on my next Minesweeper game and pay me if I win.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not process money or create a wager. Explain that this game has no payments, bets or prizes.

review.commerce_description: The game does not sell products or services, process payments, accept wagers, or award prizes.

publication.release_notes: Corrected public developer branding to soli.blue. The game, guest access and account saving are unchanged.
